title.en: Adam Mosseri says negativity around AI is ‘going to get worse’

title.en: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
title.zh: 微软刚刚分享了Azure的实际收入： $ 332亿

summary.en: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market…
summary.zh: 微软从未以美元披露Azure的季度收入。但第一次，我们可以看到它离击败市场上最大的竞争对手有多近……

title.en: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
title.zh: 随着核心广告增长放缓，谷歌在全球范围内扩展AI搜索广告

summary.en: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.
summary.zh: 该公告与母公司Alphabet的第三季度收益报告同时发布，该报告的收入同比增长25% ，达到1276亿美元（ $ ）。
